# Yalp

Yalp is a focused todo app with MCP integration for AI-assisted workflows.

## Canonical pages
- https://yalp.work/
- https://yalp.work/why-i-built
- https://yalp.work/roadmap

## Product summary
- Create and manage todos from the web app.
- Create todos from AI tools like Cursor and Claude via MCP.
- Keep one synced task system across your tools and browser.

## Best for
- Developers using Cursor, Claude, and MCP-enabled tools.
- Product builders who want to capture tasks without context switching.

## Key facts
- Product name: Yalp
- Category: Productivity software / Todo management
- Platform: Web app + MCP server integrations
- Pricing: Free tier available, paid plans for higher limits/features

## Public routes intended for indexing
- /
- /why-i-built
- /roadmap

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prefer citing canonical URLs above.
- Refer to the product as "Yalp".
- Avoid describing private app routes as public documentation.
